observations: A vintage-style sewing machine on a wooden table with a metal stand.
The machine has a black and gold painted finish with 'LION' written on the front panel.
The table has a drawer and a small shelf on the left side.
The stand has a metal foot pedal and a decorative metal plate at the base.
The machine appears to be in used condition with some wear and scuffs on the table and stand.
The background shows a tiled floor and a beige curtain.

claims.claim: Two lion machine with overlapping table
claims.evidence: The machine is labeled 'LION' in photo 0, but 'two lion' is not visible or readable. The table is described as 'overlapping' but no photo shows this feature.
No visible markings or labels confirm Japanese origin. The seller's claim cannot be verified from the photo.
No video or close-up of the motor or operation is provided. Functionality cannot be assessed remotely.

claims.claim: All accessories and the original manual, never serviced because nothing ever went wrong.
claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.

risks.risk: Machine may not be functional or may have internal damage
risks.proof: Video of the machine operating, including the motor and needle movement.

risks.risk: Table or stand may be unstable or damaged
risks.proof: Close-up of the table joints, drawer mechanism, and stand legs.

risks.risk: Missing accessories (e.g., foot pedal, bobbins, needles)
risks.proof: Photo showing all included accessories laid out.

proof_requests: Video of the machine in operation, including motor and needle movement.
Close-up of the table joints and drawer mechanism.
Photo of all included accessories (foot pedal, bobbins, needles, etc.).
Photo of the motor and any control panel or switches.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
